summary: Intrusive head of the child-sprite list that a UI window keeps for its attached sprites; the two methods take the owning window as their first argument and link/unlink a child sprite node.
evidence: Ui_ChildSprite_Attach calls func_0011FCF8(parent+0x10, parent+0x14, child+4), then child->f_c=parent and child->f_44|=0x10; Ui_ChildSprite_Detach calls func_0011FCBC(parent+0x10, child+4) and clears child->f_c. Only the two link words at +0x10/+0x14 are ever touched, so the extracted 24-byte 'class' is really the two-word list head embedded in the window, not a sprite record.

fields.evidence: Second argument of func_0011FCF8(parent+0x10,parent+0x14,child+4); sibling of +0x10 and the only other word the attach/detach pair touches, i.e. the backward link.
